articles.title: Five killed as Russia launches fresh aerial attacks across Ukraine
articles.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky accuses Russia of targeting civilian infrastructure, while Moscow reports that a warehouse was hit.

articles.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
articles.description: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 51 people killed.
articles.titleJa: インドネシアの地震で数千人が避難、救助活動が続く
articles.summary: インドネシアで発生した地震により、数百の家屋や公共施設が損壊し、少なくとも51人が死亡。数千人が避難生活を送っており、救助活動が続いている。

articles.summary: ハリケーン・ララが強風と豪雨を伴いハワイを襲っている。もし上陸すれば、ハワイにとって34年ぶりのハリケーン直撃となる可能性がある。

articles.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway

articles.summary: モロッコ当局が、スペイン領セウタへの越境を試みた数十人の移民を拘束したと報じられている。ソーシャルメディアで新たな集団越境が示唆されたため、警備が強化されていた。

articles.title: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne

articles.summary: 中央ヨーロッパの小国リヒテンシュタインが建国記念日に、女性も王位を継承できるよう規則を変更すると発表した。

articles.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
articles.description: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.
articles.titleJa: カタール、戦闘機撃墜後のイラン人パイロット3名拘束を否定
articles.summary: カタールは、戦闘機撃墜後に3人のイラン人パイロットを拘束したとのイランの主張を否定。イランは、米イラン戦争開始時にカタールが2機の戦闘機を撃墜して以来、パイロットが拘束されていると主張している。

articles.summary: バージニア州立大学で発生した銃撃事件で5人が負傷し、警察は複数の容疑者が逃走中であると発表した。銃撃は土曜日の未明、学生寮の外で発生した。

articles.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
articles.description: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.
articles.titleJa: イスラエルのレバノン南部空爆で11人死亡と当局発表
articles.summary: イスラエル軍がレバノン南部を空爆し、11人が死亡したと当局が発表した。イスラエルは、以前の兵士への攻撃に対する報復として「ヒズボラのテロインフラ」を攻撃したと述べている。

articles.title: Australian state to launch gun buyback after Bondi Beach attack
articles.description: New South Wales, where the attack took place, will offer gun owners cash to give up their firearms.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリアの州、ボンダイビーチ襲撃事件後に銃器買い取りプログラムを開始へ
articles.summary: ボンダイビーチでの襲撃事件を受け、事件が起きたニューサウスウェールズ州が、銃器所有者から銃を買い取るプログラムを開始する。

articles.title: Bus crash in Hungary kills at least 12
articles.description: The driver of a bus that has crashed in Hungary, killing at least 12 people, has been arrested, police say. The bus was carrying Polish pilgrims, reports said.
articles.titleJa: ハンガリーでバス事故、少なくとも12人死亡
articles.summary: ハンガリーでバスが衝突し、少なくとも12人が死亡した。運転手は逮捕され、バスにはポーランド人巡礼者が乗っていたとされる。

articles.title: Moscow says 600 drones targeted region overnight
articles.description: Moscow says hundreds of drones targeted the Russian capital overnight, while NATO jets were again called into action farther south. Six people were reported to have been killed in the attacks on Russia.

articles.summary: モスクワは、ロシアの首都が夜間に数百機のドローンに標的にされ、6人が死亡したと発表。NATOジェットも出動した。

articles.titleJa: 北朝鮮軍、ロシアのウクライナ部隊を増強へ
articles.summary: 情報機関によると、北朝鮮が最大5万人の兵士をロシアに送る準備をしているが、軍事専門家はウクライナ戦争の状況に根本的な変化はないと見ている。

articles.title: US: Hurricane Lala brings Hawaii heavy rain, strong winds
articles.description: The Category 1 storm passed over Hawaii's Big Island without making landfall and is expected to weaken gradually. However, the hurricane caused roads to flood and turned rivers into raging torrents.
articles.titleJa: 米国：ハリケーン・ララがハワイに豪雨と強風をもたらす
articles.summary: カテゴリー1のハリケーン「ララ」がハワイ島を通過し、上陸することなく徐々に弱まる見込みだが、道路の洪水や河川の氾濫を引き起こした。

articles.title: Africa's low-key high-stakes Strait of Hormuz diplomacy
articles.description: African governments have kept a low profile on the international stage during the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz. But that doesn't mean they haven't been engaging with the issue behind the scenes.

articles.summary: ホルムズ海峡危機において、アフリカ諸国政府は表舞台では控えめな姿勢だが、裏では問題に取り組んでいる。

articles.title: How Germany supports recovery of Berlin Pride attack victims
articles.description: After a terrorist attack, public attention tends to focus primarily on the perpetrator. But what about the victims? What support can they expect? And what lies ahead for them?

articles.summary: テロ攻撃後、加害者に焦点が当たる中、ドイツがベルリンのプライド攻撃被害者に対しどのような支援を行い、彼らに何が待ち受けているのかを問う。

articles.description: A rapidly spreading wildfire in the High Fens nature reserve near Belgium's border with Germany has scorched around 2,700 hectares. The German town of Monschau has also warned residents of possible evacuation orders.

articles.summary: ベルギーとドイツ国境付近のハイフェンス自然保護区で急速に広がる山火事が発生し、約2,700ヘクタールが焼失。ドイツのモンシャウ市も避難命令の可能性を警告。

articles.title: Iran war: Qatar denies holding missing Iranian fighter pilots
articles.description: Tehran said the three pilots "were captured alive" by Qatari forces after their fighter jets were shot down in the early days of the US-Israel war with Iran. Qatar has denied Iran's claims.

articles.summary: イランは、米・イスラエル対イラン戦争初期に撃墜された戦闘機のパイロット3人がカタール軍に捕らえられたと主張。カタールはこれを否定した。

articles.title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to enter Spanish North African exclave Ceuta
articles.description: The attempted crossings come two weeks after around 72,000 people rushed into the Spanish North African exclave from Morocco. Calls for another mass crossing had been circulating on social media this week.

articles.summary: モロッコが、スペイン北アフリカ領飛地セウタへの不法入国を試みた数十人の移民を拘束。2週間前の7万2千人規模の越境に続く動きで、SNSで呼びかけがあった。

articles.title: Lebanon says 11 killed in Israeli airstrikes
articles.description: Lebanon's prime minister denounced the attacks on villages in southern Lebanon for targeting civilians in their homes. Israel said it was firing on Hezbollah infrastructure.
articles.titleJa: レバノン、イスラエル空爆で11人死亡と発表
articles.summary: レバノン首相は、南部レバノンの村に対するイスラエルの攻撃を非難。イスラエルはヒズボラのインフラを標的としたと説明している。

articles.title: Zimbabwe boat accident death toll hits 68 as 22 more bodies recovered
articles.description:
Eighteen children among the people killed after ferry capsized on Lake Kariba
Twenty-two more bodies have been recovered after a boat accident in Zimbabwe, taking the death toll to 68, police said on Saturday.
The ferry capsized on Tuesday on Lake Kariba, on the border with Zambia. An investigation has suggested it was overloaded when it turned over during heavy winds.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ジンバブエのボート事故、死者数が68人に達する、さらに22体の遺体が回収される
articles.summary: ジンバブエのカリバ湖で発生したボート転覆事故により、死者数は68人に達しました。過積載と強風が原因とみられ、犠牲者には18人の子供が含まれています。

articles.title: Moroccan police arrest more than 100 people as they attempt to enter Ceuta
articles.description:
Border security tightened after social media posts call for another mass crossing into Spain’s north African territory
Moroccan police have arrested 111 people as they tried to enter Spain’s north African territory of Ceuta, amid ⁠tightened security on both sides after social media posts ​called for another mass crossing.
The attempted crossing on Saturday came two weeks after more than 72,000 migrants surged into Ceuta, causing tensions within the EU and prompting anti-immigration rhetoric among far-right parties worldwide. At least 96 people died trying to ⁠reach European soil.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: モロッコ警察、セウタへの入国を試みた100人以上を逮捕
articles.summary: モロッコ警察は、スペイン領セウタへの不法入国を試みた111人を逮捕しました。ソーシャルメディアで大規模な越境が呼びかけられたことを受け、国境警備が強化されていました。

articles.title: American missionary kidnapped in Niger freed after nine months
articles.description:
Kevin Rideout, who was abducted by unknown assailants in Niamey, said to be in good health and in care of US officials
An American missionary who was kidnapped in Niger in October has been released, his organisation has said.
Serving in Mission International said Kevin Rideout “is in good health in the care of US officials” and would soon be reunited with his extended family.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ニジェールで誘拐されたアメリカ人宣教師が9ヶ月ぶりに解放
articles.summary: ニジェールで昨年10月に誘拐されたアメリカ人宣教師ケビン・ライドアウト氏が解放されました。同氏は健康状態も良好で、米国当局の保護下にあるとのことです。

articles.title: DRC’s fast-growing Ebola outbreak spreads to sixth province
articles.description:
Man dies in Bas-Uele after travelling from Haut-Uele, as head of WHO says outbreak on track to be deadliest ever
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to a sixth province, officials have said, a day after the head of the World Health Organization said the outbreak was on track to surpass the deadliest in history, which killed at least 11,000 people more than a decade ago.
The current outbreak has killed more than 2,100 people out of more than 4,500 cases, according to the latest government figures released on Tuesday. At the same point in the 2014-16 outbreak in west Africa, the previous most deadly outbreak, 755 cases had been recorded, according to WHO data.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: コンゴ民主共和国の急速に拡大するエボラ出血熱、6番目の州に蔓延
articles.summary: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が6番目の州に拡大し、世界保健機関は史上最悪の流行になる可能性を警告しています。これまでに2,100人以上が死亡しています。

articles.title: French ambassador to CAR investigated over claims he hosted dozens of women
articles.description:
Disciplinary proceedings under way after security concerns raised over reported visits to official residence
France has opened disciplinary proceedings against its ambassador to Central African Republic over allegations of misconduct, after claims he brought dozens of women into his official residence, raising potential security concerns.
The investigation comes as Paris seeks to rebuild relations with CAR after their sharp deterioration in recent years amid Russia’s expanding influence in the former French colony.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: フランスの駐中央アフリカ共和国大使、数十人の女性を自宅に招いた疑惑で調査対象に
articles.summary: フランス政府は、駐中央アフリカ共和国大使が公邸に数十人の女性を招き、安全保障上の懸念が生じた疑惑を受け、懲戒手続きを開始しました。

articles.title: Ontario free to axe Toronto bike lanes, region’s top court rules
articles.description:
Win is significant for region’s premier, Doug Ford, who blames protected zones for city’s traffic ills
The Ontario government is now free to rip out Toronto’s bike lanes on its busiest streets after the region’s top court ruled in favour of the province on Friday, overturning a lower court’s decision that decreed removal would violate constitutional rights.
The win is significant for Ontario’s premier, Doug Ford, and his government, who have long railed against Toronto’s bike lanes, blaming the protected zones for the city’s traffic ills.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: オンタリオ州、トロントの自転車レーン撤去を自由に、地域最高裁が判決
articles.summary: オンタリオ州の最高裁判所は、トロントの自転車レーン撤去を巡る判決で州政府の主張を支持しました。これにより、ダグ・フォード州首相が推進する自転車レーン撤去が可能になります。

articles.title: Canadian plasma clinics pause collections after deaths of two donors
articles.description:
Grifols, which runs private chain of clinics, to temporarily stop taking donations after new government investigation
A chain of private plasma donation clinics in Canada has said it is pausing collections after the deaths of two donors and a new government investigation into potential unsafe practices.
Grifols, a Spanish healthcare company which runs 17 clinics in Canada and is the country’s only private clinic for plasma donation, said it informed Health Canada of its decision to temporarily pause collections on Wednesday.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: カナダのプラズマ採血クリニック、ドナー2名の死亡を受け採血を一時停止
articles.summary: カナダのプライベートプラズマ採血クリニックが、ドナー2名の死亡と新たな政府調査を受け、採血を一時停止しました。安全性に関する懸念が浮上しています。

articles.title: BP to develop offshore gasfield in Venezuela with firms linked to Trump administration
articles.description:
Move will be one of first large-scale foreign investments in country since US ousted leader Nicolás Maduro in January
BP has answered Donald Trump’s call for oil companies to help rebuild Venezuela’s fossil fuel industry with new plans to develop a large offshore gasfield.
BP will partner with two oil firms with close links to the Trump administration to develop the second phase of the Loran gasfield, in one of the first large-scale foreign investments in Venezuela since the US ousted its leader Nicolás Maduro in January.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: BP、トランプ政権とつながりのある企業とベネズエラの沖合ガス田を開発へ
articles.summary: BPがトランプ政権と関係のある2社と共同で、ベネズエラの沖合ガス田開発を進める計画です。これは、米国がマドゥロ大統領を追放して以来、初の大型外国投資の一つとなります。

articles.title: Former Mexican governor charged in case of 43 students who vanished in 2014
articles.description:
Ángel Aguirre indicted in case that rocked Mexico and became symbol of its brutal cartel violence
The former governor of Guerrero state in Mexico has been formally charged over his alleged involvement in the disappearance of 43 students in 2014, a case that has become a symbol of the country’s brutal cartel violence and government impunity.
Ángel Aguirre, who was arrested last week, is accused of forced disappearance and obstruction of justice for ordering the destruction of surveillance tapes that may have shed light on what happened to the students from the Ayotzinapa teacher training college on the night of 26 September 2014.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 元メキシコ州知事、2014年に失踪した43人の学生事件で起訴される
articles.summary: メキシコの元ゲレロ州知事アンヘル・アギーレ氏が、2014年に43人の学生が失踪した事件に関与したとして正式に起訴されました。この事件はメキシコのカルテル暴力と政府の免責の象徴となっています。

articles.title: Canadian airline WestJet agrees to settle flight attendants’ sexual harassment class action
articles.description:
Female staff alleged company failed to maintain safe workplace, after allegations of sexual assault against pilot
The Canadian airline WestJet has agreed to pay C$4.5m (£2.4m) to settle a decade-long sexual harassment class action lawsuit levelled by its female flight attendants, who alleged the company failed to maintain a safe workplace.
The suit followed allegations by Mandalena Lewis, a former flight attendant, that a pilot had sexually assaulted her and a colleague, but that WestJet kept the pilot flying, thereby putting other employees at risk.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: カナダの航空会社ウエストジェット、客室乗務員のセクハラ集団訴訟で和解に合意
articles.summary: カナダの航空会社ウエストジェットは、女性客室乗務員らが提起したセクハラ集団訴訟に対し、450万カナダドルの和解金を支払うことに合意しました。

articles.title: Morocco prevents hundreds of migrants from crossing into Ceuta
articles.description: Moroccan security forces on Saturday broke up hundreds of migrants who had been hiding near Castillejos in a bid to reach Ceuta. The operation comes weeks after the mass crossing attempt that left 141 people dead.

articles.title: At least 12 people killed in Polish tourist bus crash in Hungary
articles.description: By 3 a.m. on Sunday, the disaster management service reported that firefighters had so far rescued thirty-five people from the coach, while several passengers had been trapped beneath the vehicle.
articles.titleJa: ハンガリーでポーランド人観光バス事故、少なくとも12人死亡
articles.summary: ハンガリーで発生したポーランド人観光バスの事故で、少なくとも12人が死亡。消防隊が35人を救助しましたが、多数の乗客が車両の下敷きになっていました。

articles.title: Pillory linden of Großpörthen: 900-year-old tree with a grim history
articles.description: Up to 900 years old and nearly ten metres thick, the Prangerlinde in Großpörthen, Saxony-Anhalt, still bears an old iron collar on its trunk, a unique natural and historical monument.

articles.title: Exploring Andorra: The best things to do in the microstate aside from skiing and shopping

International trade agreements help governments take account of these cross-border spillovers (terms-of-trade externalities) by encouraging reciprocal negotiations over trade policy. While these negotiations will reduce trade protection, they will not necessarily lead to free trade. But if governments do not generally commit themselves to free trade, why has freedom of transit for goods been seen differently?
